steps.content: This is the entrance to the conference hall. The interior has been trashed, its walls crumbling, its floor dotted with round pits. From the pits grow dense bushes of contamination spikes, inside each of which swirls a pool of dark purple light.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Well, I've never had a fight here. When this is over, I'm gonna, as per usual, do a bit of graffiti as a memento.
Her voice is slightly tense.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, you okay?
You're not feeling very well. Since you got here, the shackles connected to Zoya have been in a manic state. Something has been continuously tearing at your consciousness.
You're very close to Zoya. It's only normal to be affected. But something is wrong with this place...
The attendees, the guards, and the soldiers who ambushed Zoya... all of them have simply vanished. They didn't turn into Corruptors or end up as corpses.
...They're dead, someone killed them.
036 squats down beside a pit. It seems to be the upshot of a powerful punch, with spiderweb-like cracks radiating from its center. He runs a hand over the cracks, and it comes up with viscous blood.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhhh!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Step back!
Hecate shields you behind her. But pits of death like this have overrun the entire ground, hemming you in.
There's no sign they were mentally contaminated. They were killed at the instant of the contamination outbreak. This is what's left of their remains.
At the other end of the hall is a pile of FAC members' corpses.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: All those who made it here were also eradicated.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is... the power of the inheritance? So brutal...
The Black Ring hasn't formed yet. There's still time. We must stop it before this tragedy is repeated.
...He means that there's still time to kill Zoya.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Die...!! Ahhh!!
She is still fighting.
She is ahead of you. Her power is swelling to the utmost, and her feverish emotions are churning—anger, sadness, and hatred, mixed with some irrepressible impulse.
It's not over yet. We still have a chance.
...If that's the case, it'll be great.
You need something to stabilize her, anything that you can use to awaken her. You need more measures at your disposal.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No. We're the only ones who've made it here after the outbreak.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Should we wait for him?
We don't have time.

As if a magnetic field has been turned on, masses of dark purple substance slowly come into being in the air, twisting and transforming. They then land, on their feet—these powerful monsters you've never seen before.
<color=#dg1f1f>It</color> senses you through the shackles, just like you do Zoya.
